_about: The shape of a season in one sentence, for the almanac's story of the season (scripts/sim/SeasonTale.gd). Same shape as the career story's bank (data/tales/career.json): each angle declares the slots its phrases may use, and CareerTale.validate rejects any other. Numbers come in ready-made from the slots, so a phrase can change the words around a number but never the number. Voice: the senior coach, we/our for the club. Every phrase says a thing that happened and never whether it was good. One phrase is picked per season from the year and the club, so a season reads the same every time.

coach: We were {first_rec} after {split} and won {late_won} of the next {late_n}.
From {first_rec} after {split}, we won {late_won} of the next {late_n}.
We were {first_rec} after {split} and won {late_won} of the next {late_n}.
We were {first_rec} after {split}, then won {late_won} of the next {late_n}.
We won our last {run} games, the Grand Final the last of them.
We won {run} in a row from {from}.
We lost {run} in a row from {from}.
